description: This course will introduce students to the art and skills of translation. It will provide students practical experience translating technical and scientific documents from Spanish to English and from English to Spanish. Prerequisites: Spanish 1180.

course: SPANISH 4302  Phonetics and Phonology of Spanish (LEC 3.0)
description: Theoretical and practical approach to the phonetics and phonology of Spanish from the dual perspective of the mental representation of the sound system and pronunciation within syllables, words and phrases. Practice in listening comprehension, and sound discrimination with transcription exercises. Prerequisites: Any Spanish course at the 2000 or 3000 level.

course: SPANISH 4350  Spanish Literature, Science, and Technology (LEC 3.0)
description: Discussion of unique texts, representations, and collections from distinct Spanish-speaking societies. Consideration of the social and cultural functions of science and technology through the lens of literature. Inquiry about how different societies have equated advancement and progress with challenges, solutions, and controversy. Prerequisites: Any Spanish 2000 or 3000-level course or equivalent.
